profiles.description: Address-to-housing-dossier: land-value zones with valuation dates, rent-index editions and cells, development-plan stages, permit and completion statistics and housing indicator vintages, each with source, unit, currency and as-of basis, side by side

workflow_defaults.as_of: latest valuation date, dated stage, edition valid_from and vintage not after the requested date, with the selection basis
workflow_defaults.boundaries: a point on a zone boundary or in no published zone is reported as such; nothing is chosen or interpolated
workflow_defaults.sources: different sources, editions and vintages side by side; disagreements are listed, never resolved
workflow_defaults.transit: stops as accessibility context only (optional housing-transit-context feature)

vocabulary.Bodenrichtwert: a land value per square metre for a published zone on its Stichtag (valuation date), not a price of any parcel
vocabulary.Stichtag: the valuation date a land value applies to
vocabulary.Mietspiegel: a rent index edition: ranges per published cell, valid from the edition date; not a rent for a dwelling
vocabulary.Wohnlage: the source-labelled residential-area category of a Mietspiegel edition; not a value or score
vocabulary.Bebauungsplan: a development plan with its published procedural stage and stage dates
vocabulary.vintage: the publication a statistic was read from; revised figures are new vintages

optional_features.description: Housing, land-value and urban-planning layers: BORIS land-value zones with valuation dates, Mietspiegel editions and cells, Bebauungsplan stages, Wohnlagen, Statistik Berlin-Brandenburg permits and completions and Destatis GENESIS 31111/31231 vintages, projected onto places with as-of answers, citation links to legal works and decisions, and subscription monitors. No valuation, rent, investment or tenancy advice and no interpolated value.

the feature's own dossier entry points use these operations
zones, plans and districts are Geospatial features queried by containment
addresses and parcels resolve through reviewable place resolution
rent-index editions and plans link to Berlin legal works by explicit citation
Destatis housing series are dataset-series vintages in the ObservationStore
plans link to decisions and dossiers by their identifiers

housing layers and tables are acquired through the source-pack runtime

optional_features.description: Optional accessibility context for housing dossiers: transit stops near a place from the VBB GTFS feed, carrying no valuation meaning.

requires.reason: transit stops are listed inside housing dossiers
stops come from the acquired GTFS feed as accessibility context only

optional_features.description: Critical infrastructure registries: power plants, generating units, pipelines, LNG terminals, transmission lines, substations, gas points and mines as published by WRI GPPD, Global Energy Monitor (declared releases, non-commercial constraint), bounded OpenStreetMap Overpass extracts (ODbL), EIA layers and ENTSOG, with status and capacity revisions, owner assertions as published, reviewable asset reconciliation, place and operator answers as of a date and subscription monitors. Geometries use the existing geospatial store. No vulnerability assessment or valuation.

Climate and Environment facilities (which depend on Geospatial) are linked by shared identifier read-only when that bundle is installed, and skipped otherwise.
